answers.brief_reasoning: A trade deficit happens when imports are greater than exports. A budget deficit happens when government spending is greater than tax revenue.

The item fits topic 6.1 and skill 1.D, needs no stimulus, and takes about 60 seconds. It is low in difficulty, but acceptable.
